limitations_or_use_note: On printed p.519 the article says Trisula resulted in 2,000 killed and thousands detained/displaced, citing NYT 11 Aug 1968 at note 37; the original NYT article was not accessed. title: Two Former Communist Leaders Under Threat of Execution in Indonesia

title: Keputusan Presiden Republik Indonesia No. 48 Tahun 1962 tentang Pembentukan Organisasi Pertahanan Sipil

source_type: Official Indonesian legal primary text; BPK-hosted PDF
access_status: Full 2-page PDF text opened 2026-11-18; title, operative clauses and signature/date lines checked.
limitations_or_use_note: Creates nationwide civil defense as a non-military component of national defense, with central and regional government mobilizing national resources; central planning/control assigned to Minister of National Security. It is a general statutory framework, not a specific AURI base order, Fifth Force decision, or proof of training implementation.

title: Keputusan Presiden Republik Indonesia No. 128 Tahun 1962 tentang Perencanaan, Penyelenggaraan, Koordinasi dan Pengawasan Pertahanan Sipil dan Perlawanan Rakyat
creator_or_institution: President of the Republic of Indonesia
source_type: Official Indonesian legal primary text; BPK-hosted PDF
access_status: Full 1-page PDF text opened 2026-11-18; delegation, retroactive date and signature checked.
limitations_or_use_note: Transfers central planning, implementation, coordination, control and supervision for civil defense and popular resistance to the First Deputy Minister for Defense/Security; local arrangements are to follow regulations issued under that authority. The law does not by itself show how a 1965 course was approved or executed.

title: Undang-Undang No. 14 Tahun 1962 tentang Mobilisasi Umum (ratification of PERPU No. 1/1962)
creator_or_institution: President of the Republic of Indonesia; Republic of Indonesia
source_type: Official Indonesian legal primary text and BPK legal metadata
access_status: Full 12-page PDF text and BPK metadata opened 2026-11-18; articles 1–8, enactment/effective dates and later repeal metadata checked.
limitations_or_use_note: Provides a general mechanism for the President/Supreme Commander, after hearing the National Defense Council, to declare general mobilization and call citizens; goals include trained popular resistance supporting armed forces and civil-defense duties. It permits calling healthy men and women aged 18–50 but does not document a declaration or call-up in 1965, nor the specific Lubang Buaya/AURI course.

title: Politik Militer AURI dalam Pemerintahan Sukarno 1962–1966
creator_or_institution: Humaidi; thesis, Faculty of Humanities, Universitas Indonesia
source_type: University thesis / secondary reconstruction of AURI politics
access_status: Relevant pp.67–69 were opened in the prior review; this pass cross-checked the chapter’s source chain and the related methodology PDF. Current direct viewer returns a CAPTCHA.
limitations_or_use_note: Reports Sujono’s July cohort counts, Omar Dhani’s responses, the second course, participants/instructors and the early-September closure/26 September date. Key training passages cite Aristides Katoppo 1999, pp.29–36 and Omar Dhani’s defense; they are not independent archival records. The broad statement that AURI institutionally “knew nothing” is an author inference and should be separated from evidence that senior officers received reports or ordered closure.

title: Gerakan 30 September: Pemberontakan Partai Komunis Indonesia—Latar Belakang, Aksi dan Penumpasannya (1994), relevant Chapter IV transcription
creator_or_institution: Sekretariat Negara Republik Indonesia; text reproduced by a personal-history blog
source_type: Later official state/military narrative, accessible here only as third-party web transcription; catalog records confirm title/publisher but book not read
access_status: Relevant transcript paragraphs on AURI Hansip/HANREV, Rawabinong and 28 September claims opened 2026-11-18; bibliographic catalogs checked. Catalogs give conflicting pagination (118 vs 173 pages). No original book scan or 1965 instruction/radiogram was accessed.
limitations_or_use_note: The narrative adopts a New Order accusatory frame and asserts secret PKI control, a 28 August CC decision, four battalions/2,000 people, and operational assignments. It is evidence of a later official account; underlying order, coded radiograms, roster, and decision papers remain unverified. Blog transcription integrity is unestablished.
